shared_elements: tall vertical monument/pillar with stacked carved registers
figures carved in high relief on a column-like shaft
anthropomorphic/animal faces in frontal or profile view
stacked composition read from top to bottom
justification: Both depict a tall vertical shaft carved in relief with motifs stacked in registers from top to bottom, which gives a loose compositional correspondence. But the actual content differs sharply: A shows large rounded, sculptural birds (a hooked-beak raptor, a pair of confronted birds) and interlaced crossed bands, while B shows a frontal elaborately costumed human figure with headdress framed by dense columns of small glyph-like blocks, with no birds or interlace and a far more crowded, ornamental surface.
